seoTitle: Which Sopranos Character Are You? The Sopranos Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take The Sopranos test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Tony, Carmela, Christopher, Paulie, Silvio, Meadow, AJ or Dr. Melfi — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the boss who runs everything except his own head, the one who knows more than she lets on, or the superstitious old-timer with a story for everything? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle family, loyalty and trouble, and find out which Sopranos character you are.

characters.name: Tony Soprano
characters.title: The Conflicted Boss
characters.summary: Charismatic, powerful and full of contradictions. You run everything — but you can't quite run your own head.
description: Like Tony, you're in charge. He runs a New Jersey crime family and a household, and both are exhausting.
You feel things more deeply than people think. Tony started therapy after a panic attack — triggered by a family of ducks leaving his pool.
You're charming, funny and generous, and you can turn frightening in a heartbeat.
characters.flaw: Your temper and your appetite — for everything — get the better of you.
characters.signature: A bathrobe, a morning newspaper and a plate of gabagool.
characters.clashReason: they'd make every decision about themselves

characters.name: Carmela Soprano
characters.title: The Knowing Matriarch
characters.summary: Sharp, devout and determined to protect your family. You know more than you let on — and you've made your peace with it. Mostly.
description: Like Carmela, you run the home and you run it well. Nothing happens in that house without her knowing.
You're smarter than people assume. Carmela sees exactly what her life is built on — and wrestles with it constantly.
You want security for your kids, respect for yourself and, occasionally, a very nice new house.
characters.flaw: You look the other way when it suits you.
characters.signature: A fur coat, a baked ziti and a very knowing look.
characters.clashReason: they'd look the other way when it suits them

characters.name: Christopher Moltisanti
characters.title: The Restless Dreamer
characters.summary: Impulsive, ambitious and hungry for more. You want a bigger life — you're just not sure which one.
description: Like Christopher, you've got big dreams. He wanted to rise in the family — and to become a Hollywood screenwriter.
You're impulsive and emotional. Chris acts fast and thinks later.
You want the respect of the people you look up to more than anything, and it tears you apart.
characters.flaw: You act on impulse, and you struggle with your vices.
characters.signature: A screenplay, a leather jacket and a very short fuse.
characters.clashReason: they'd be reckless and blame everyone else

characters.name: Paulie Walnuts
characters.title: The Superstitious Old-Timer
characters.summary: Loyal, vain and hilariously set in your ways. You've got a story for everything — and a superstition for the rest.
description: Like Paulie, you're old-school. The hair, the tracksuits, the rules — everything done the way it's always been done.
You're superstitious and a little paranoid. Paulie sees omens everywhere.
You're loyal to the bone, and you've got some of the best stories in the whole show — including a very long night lost in the Pine Barrens.
characters.signature: Silver-winged hair, a tracksuit and a story nobody asked for.

characters.name: Silvio Dante
characters.title: The Loyal Consigliere
characters.summary: Calm, loyal and the steady voice in the room. You're the right-hand man everyone trusts.
description: Like Silvio, you're the adviser. He's Tony's consigliere and one of his oldest friends.
You're calm and loyal, and you keep your head when everyone else loses theirs.
You've got a showman side too. Silvio runs the Bada Bing club and loves doing his famous movie impressions.
characters.flaw: You'd rather advise than lead — even when you need to step up.
characters.signature: A sharp suit, a big pompadour and an Al Pacino impression.
characters.clashReason: they'd stay loyal even when they shouldn't

characters.name: Meadow Soprano
characters.title: The Smart Rebel
characters.summary: Intelligent, independent and questioning everything. You're going places — and you're not sure how you feel about where you came from.
description: Like Meadow, you're smart and ambitious. She went to Columbia and set her sights on a big career.
You question everything, especially your family. Meadow sees through a lot of what her parents try to hide.
But family is complicated, and loyalty keeps pulling you back.
characters.flaw: You justify things you know aren't right when it's your family.
characters.signature: A college acceptance letter and a pointed question at the dinner table.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you exactly what's wrong with you

characters.name: AJ Soprano
characters.title: The Lost Soul
characters.summary: Sensitive, restless and still figuring it all out. You feel the weight of the world — and you're not sure what to do with it.
description: Like AJ, you're a deep feeler. He struggles to find direction and feels the world's problems very personally.
You don't love expectations. AJ never quite fit the path his father imagined for him.
You're funnier and more thoughtful than people give you credit for, and you're still searching for where you belong.
characters.flaw: You drift, and you avoid responsibility.
characters.signature: A video game controller and a very big existential question.

characters.name: Dr. Jennifer Melfi
characters.title: The Principled Observer
characters.summary: Calm, perceptive and principled. You see through people — even the most dangerous ones.
description: Like Dr. Melfi, you understand people. She's Tony's psychiatrist and probably the person who understands him best.
You're principled. Melfi holds a line even when it would be easier — or more satisfying — not to.
You're fascinated by what makes people tick, and you know when you're being manipulated.
characters.flaw: You get drawn in by people you know you should walk away from.
characters.signature: A notebook, a calm voice and a long, meaningful silence.

questions.text: It's a big family dinner at your place. You...

options.text: Sit at the head of the table and hold court
Cook everything and quietly run the whole room
Bring up the one thing nobody wants to talk about
Turn up late and stare at your phone

questions.text: Someone disrespects you in public. You...

options.text: Handle it. Personally
Never forget it. You'll bring it up for twenty years
Stay calm and work out the smartest response
Wonder what's going on with them that they needed to do that

questions.text: You get a big, unexpected pile of cash. You...

options.text: Put it towards a new house. A really nice one
Spend it on something flashy before anyone asks for a cut
Hide it somewhere nobody would ever think to look
Treat everyone to dinner. Loudly

questions.text: Something feels off, and you can't explain why. You...

options.text: Take it as an omen and change your plans immediately
Trust your gut and act fast
Sit with the feeling and try to understand it
Ask the question everyone's avoiding

questions.text: You're feeling low and can't shake it. You...

options.text: Finally see a therapist. Don't tell anyone
Keep busy and act like everything's fine
Sink into it. The world's a terrible place anyway
Pour it into something creative

questions.text: A friend wants you to do something you know is wrong. You...

options.text: Refuse. There are lines you won't cross
Do it. Loyalty comes first
Go along with it, then feel terrible about it
Argue about it — then go along anyway

questions.text: Someone you've always looked up to lets you down. You...

options.text: Feel it deeply — and act out
Stay loyal. Keep the disappointment to yourself
Call it out. They should know better
Blame them for everything that's wrong in your life

questions.text: You're getting dressed for a normal day. You...

options.text: Tracksuit. Hair perfect
Bathrobe until noon
Something expensive and classy
A smart blazer. Professional, always
Big family lunch, then a nap in front of the TV
Church in the morning, the racetrack in the afternoon
Old records, loud, all afternoon
Video games until the sun goes down

questions.text: Your family expects you to go into the family business. You...

options.text: Of course. You've wanted in since you were a kid
Try it, hate it, and quit
No. You're building your own life
Take it over and run it better than they ever did

questions.text: You find out your partner's money comes from something illegal. It pays for your home and your kids' school. You...

options.text: Stay, and look the other way. The kids come first
Leave. You couldn't live with it
Tell yourself it's more complicated than it looks
Ask how you can get a piece of it

questions.text: You're a therapist. Your charming, funny new patient slowly turns out to be dangerous. You...

options.text: Keep treating them. Everyone deserves help
Refer them on. Why take the risk?
Carry on. You can handle anyone
Report them. There are rules for this
